# Public 32-byte hex constants that bundled dependencies put in the npm
# tarballs (noble-curves, ethers, viem docs). audit-npm-tarballs.mjs fails on
# any other standalone 0x + 64 hex value, because that is the shape of a
# private key.
#
# Each line: sha256 of the lowercased value including "0x", then what it is.
# Before adding a line, check the value is a published constant in the library
# that carries it, never a key. Reviewed 2026-11-22 against the latest beta
# tarballs of all 16 public packages.

b4a5e94d493bb5b92407024416ee5d9811f4f3a6d5a01043bd0aa9369e533cb6 # "Hello world" padded (viem toHex doc example)
